objective: Build the missing bottom-up bridge from camera pixels to time-aligned, uncertainty-aware robot base-frame scene points.

request_interpretation.curriculum_intent: Build foundations before higher robot perception topics and make the article sufficient for hard transfer reasoning.
request_interpretation.content_intent: Reconstruct source claims, equations, assumptions, failures, and implementation contracts instead of summarizing.
request_interpretation.visual_intent: Use measurable interactive Viz with production visual polish, responsive framing, and no clipping.
request_interpretation.provenance_intent: Retain why each section exists, what source supports it, and what the source does not establish.

gap_audit.existing_coverage: robot-ai-top-down briefly names camera intrinsics, extrinsics, depth, TF, and timestamps; robot-kinematics covers generic rigid frames.
gap_audit.scope_boundary: Detection, segmentation, learned depth, temporal object fusion, and planning-scene construction remain the next article.

source_decisions.boundary: An API fit is not evidence that a dataset is well conditioned or deployment-valid.
The reported simulations and real camera do not guarantee a modern robot deployment; the approximate 45-degree simulation result is not a universal collection rule.
Original accuracy and speed are specific to its equipment and experiment.
ROS conventions cannot repair a driver that publishes wrong stamps or frames.
Only a bridge is included; full rolling-shutter calibration is deferred.

private_transfer_gate.publication_policy: Do not render the problem as filler; map every required insight to public evidence.

implementation_decisions: Use eight narrative sections matching the physical data path from pixel to planning scene.
Use HTML metric ledgers for dense labels and SVG only for geometry to preserve mobile readability.
Use red only for actual invariant failure and stable blue/violet/amber/emerald semantic roles.
Every interaction changes a numeric output such as ray angle, miss distance, pixel shift, condition proxy, residual, loop closure, point error, or covariance.
Use String.raw for every LaTeX display and add Korean in-equation mappings in the shared annotation registry.

repair_log.defect: The first Playwright pass used viewportSize with browser.newPage, so Chromium silently stayed at 1280 px and produced a false mobile pass.
repair_log.diagnosis: innerWidth and document clientWidth were both 1280 while the requested width was 390.
repair_log.repair: Changed the option to viewport, invalidated the earlier screenshots, and reran every viewport.
repair_log.verification: The corrected run reported inner layout behavior at 360/390 and exposed the SVG readability defects below.

repair_log.defect: Desktop 620-700 unit SVG scenes were scaled to about half size on phones, making embedded legends and geometry too small.
repair_log.diagnosis: Document overflow was zero, but visual inspection showed 5-7 px effective labels and weak scene emphasis.
repair_log.repair: Added mobile-specific compositions for image geometry, distortion, pose diversity, time alignment, ray-plane intersection, and Zhang constraints; moved explanatory legends to normal 12 px HTML text.
repair_log.verification: Corrected 390 px screenshots show readable geometry and captions with no clipped SVG text.

repair_log.defect: Four metrics stacked as one column created excess vertical length; the hand-eye returned transform previously broke into nearly one character per line in the invalid desktop-only screenshot audit.
repair_log.diagnosis: The dense numeric outputs can safely use two mobile columns if long values are shortened semantically.
repair_log.repair: Added an opt-in mobileColumns mode to MetricGrid, used two columns in these Viz, and split the 3D point into x value plus y/z note.
repair_log.verification: 360/390 px screenshots have stable two-column ledgers with no element or document overflow.

repair_log.defect: Large multi-axis tilt rotations made Zhang target cards overlap in the first mobile-specific layout.
repair_log.diagnosis: The rotated bounding boxes were wider and taller than their unrotated grid cells.
repair_log.repair: Reduced board width, increased horizontal separation and row pitch, and made SVG height depend on the row count.
repair_log.verification: Separate diverse-state screenshots for both concept and paper Viz show no card overlap.

repair_log.defect: Several in-equation underbrace explanations still used English phrases even though the surrounding prose was Korean.
repair_log.diagnosis: The source LaTeX and the responsive annotation registry must be updated together because the source string is the lookup key.
repair_log.repair: Localized all 12 concept and 5 paper equation explanations and synchronized the registry keys and mobile split renderings.
repair_log.verification: Missing formula annotations and KaTeX errors are zero at all four viewports.
